registration.notes: Front-door composition, seam 8 (FD-1 ONE_SEAM_PER_STEP, FD-12 as ruled: SCREEN_5_TYPED_DATA_USE_DECLARATIONS, LOCAL_SQLITE_UNDER_RUNTIME_VOLUME, DECLARED_BY_PRESENTED_UNPROVEN, V2_AMENDMENT_TWO_OPERATIONS, DECLARE_IS_THE_ONLY_WRITE): build_studio_context receives one further seam, the tenant-bound SqliteDataUseDeclarations file named by UGENCE_STUDIO_DATA_USE_DECLARATIONS_PATH under the writable runtime volume (data-use-admission 0.2.0), with the recording composition this deployment's name and version; the frozen v2 contract is amended a fourth time (v2-A4) by one write and one read; declare is the only write and the record confers nothing; the record carries an opaque data_ref and never the data, and its classification, purpose and residency labels stay uninterpreted; no egress restriction is expressible and none is invented; no credential, LIVE path or egress destination is added, and decision_store, governance_hook and console_base_url stay absent. Supersedes the seam-7 registration, which is never edited; a later seam registers a new record superseding this one.
